title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00070 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
00:00 - 01:15: Changed handling equipment. Removed master bushing, installed spider, installed power rollers, installed reel for spooling control line
01:15 - 03:45: Pulled tubing from 3075m to 2957m. Removed control line clamps, spooled control line, l/d tubing joints. Average pulling rate 4 joints/hour
03:45 - 04:30: Experienced communication problems w/ CSG tong. Changed door sensor
04:30 - 06:00: Pulled tubing from 2957m to 2874m. Removed control line clamps, spooled control line, l/d tubing joints. Average pulling rate 7 joints/hour
06:00 - 06:15: Experienced communication problems w/ CSG tong
06:15 - 08:45: Pulled tubing from 2874m to 2685m. Removed control line clamps, spooled control line, l/d tubing joints. Average pulling rate 6,4 joints/hour
08:45 - 09:45: HTS belt fault occurred, contacted electronics technician
09:45 - 10:45: Pulled tubing from 2685m to 2614m. Removed control line clamps, spooled control line, l/d tubing joints. Average pulling rate 6,0 joints/hour
10:45 - 11:00: Performed pre-job meeting to rig down CSG handling equipment
11:00 - 11:15: Pull slips
11:15 - 11:45: Pulled and l/d DHSV
11:45 - 12:00: Pulled TBG joint, removed control lines and run joint back into hole
12:00 - 12:30: Changed out handling equipment to 5,5in DP
12:30 - 12:45: Cleared rig floor
12:45 - 13:00: P/u and m/u swedge to tubing
13:00 - 14:00: R/d control line reel, meanwhile disconnected hoses and made CSG tong ready to remove
14:00 - 14:30: P/u single and RIH from 2574m to 2585m
14:30 - 14:45: Pulled master bushing and installed ps21
14:45 - 17:00: Continued RIH on 5,5in DP from 2585m to3070m. Filled pipe half way. Average RIH speed 214 m/hour.
17:00 - 17:30: M/u TDS and staged up pumps to 3000l/m, 180 bar. Pumped 32m3 sea water and 20m3 wash pill, displaced combination wiper plug out of TBG 3070m)
17:30 - 20:00: M/u side entry sub assembly. Performed pre-job meeting for cement job. Installed cement line and pressure tested same to 300bar. OK

Balanced cement plug mixed and pumped 9,2 m3 of 1,9sg cement slurry, 600 l/min. Displaced the cement to the rig floor with 2890 l of drill water. Zeroed volume counters. Displaced the cement with 45,6 m3 strokes) of sea water, 2000 l/min/ 65 bar. Pulled out of cement to 2868m of cement)

Circulated out upper 50m of cement at 2700l/min, pressure went from 185bar down to 140bar as cemented was circulated out of well. Observed cement returns on surface. Theoretical volume of returned cement was 1. 8m3. Totally circulated 270m3. TOC at 2868m
